name: Leonardo Sbaraglia
bio:
Leonardo Máximo Sbaraglia is one of the biggest movie stars in Argentina (born June 30, 1970)Argentine film, with extensive credits in Argentina and Spain. He also has worked in Mexico and his first English-language role was in Red Lights.
